scripts.setup:captions: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv\Scripts\python.exe transcribe.py --download
scripts.setup:transcription: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install faster-whisper==1.2.1 numpy pyinstaller && .venv/bin/python transcribe_stream.py --download && .venv/bin/pyinstaller --noconfirm --onedir --distpath python-worker --workpath /tmp/notetaker-pyinstaller --specpath /tmp --name transcribe-worker --collect-all faster_whisper --collect-all ctranslate2 --collect-all tokenizers transcribe_stream.py
scripts.setup:transcription:mac: test -d .whisper.cpp || git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.9.4 https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp.git .whisper.cpp; cmake -S .whisper.cpp -B .whisper.cpp/build -DGGML_METAL=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON; cmake --build .whisper.cpp/build --config Release -j 8; bash .whisper.cpp/models/download-ggml-model.sh base.en
scripts.setup:transcription:win: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install faster-whisper==1.2.1 numpy pyinstaller && .venv\Scripts\python.exe transcribe_stream.py --download && .venv\Scripts\pyinstaller.exe --noconfirm --onedir --distpath python-worker --workpath %TEMP%\notetaker-pyinstaller --specpath %TEMP% --name transcribe-worker --collect-all faster_whisper --collect-all ctranslate2 --collect-all tokenizers transcribe_stream.py

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Local transcription labels speech from your microphone as You.
